The '''TNV ''Vigilant''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was used by the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Baltor Yfridian]].
